Everything for this course is on this site. The [schedule](/index.qmd) is the
landing page — slides, labs, assignments and examlets all hang off it as they
go live. The [syllabus](/syllabus.qmd) has the grading scheme and course
policies, including the one on generative AI.

First things first:

- Work through [Getting started](/getting-started.qmd) and
  [Setup](/setup.qmd) to get your machine ready.
- Enrol in [PrairieLearn]({{< var course.prairielearn >}}), where all labs,
  homework, assignments and examlets live.
- Lab Intro is open now.
